rule: Hit order in the engine: block or counter or takedamage first; on a normal hit, the contact flash spawns (skipped by no_flash), the owner combo timer is set, the attacker pauses only if not already paused or airborne (adds pause_add to its timers), the target always pauses by pause_add, and the hit sound plays last with pitch set by damage: speed = 100 - (attack_force - 5) clamped to 60..100 (or 100 with noslowfx). Freeze sets a timer only when the target has none. Bounce sets a fixed 4 px screen quake unless disabled. Frame quakes set level->quake per repeat.

data_fields.name: freeze_ticks
data_fields.unit: engine _time ticks (two command forms use different units)

keep: Attacker pause gated on not already paused, or airborne
Damage-to-pitch curve on the hit sound, clamped
Contact flash skipped by a per-attack no_flash flag
Freeze timer set only when the target has none
Frame quake as per-animation data (framestart, repeat, v)
change: Target pause stacks in this donor (always added); cap it and take max, not sum
One unit for all freeze times (the donor mixes raw ints and float times times game_speed)
One named tuple for the attack (the donor has two positional layouts for the same fields)
Freeze length comes from the server event, not the client
Our own flash sprite, palette and sound set
look_test: Flag on the existing dummy duel, published to /preview/ with no release rows. Modes: A baseline (no flash, no pause, no pitch change); B contact flash plus gated attacker pause (4 ticks) and target pause (6 ticks) plus damage-to-pitch curve plus 4 px bounce quake on heavy only; C B with three attackers hitting one target in turn, to show the stacking cap. Dom judges whether the pitch reads as heavier with no number on screen and whether the three-on-one freeze reads as impact or lag.
